name: Kuberan Global Edu Solutions Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2013, Kuberan Global Edu Solutions Ltd is in the business of providing tech-driven education[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
KGESL operates in the education sector with a focus on test preparation. Its key offerings include:
a) Banking exam courses
b) MBA entrance exam coaching
c) Staff Selection Commission preparation
d) Life Insurance Corporation exam training
e) Accounting and professional courses such as: Chartered Accountant (CA), Certified Management Accountant, and Company Secretary

cons: Stock is trading at 5.59 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -9.91% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -6.20% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 223 days.
Working capital days have increased from 285 days to 446 days
